gen-gf-pangolin-fs-technor: Hand-drawn warmth up top, glowing neon tubes below. Pangolin keeps its single-nib lowercase tall and friendly, while Technor holds one steady line thickness, so it is made for quick glances.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-bhutuka-expanded-one: Commanding Paprika fills the line, its lowercase standing like capitals. BhuTuka Expanded One has no hairlines at all, so extended reading slows to a leisurely walk, curvy and unhurried.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-kiwi-maru: Loud and spaced-out, Paprika fills each line with lowercase that stands like capitals, then hands over to Kiwi Maru. Kiwi Maru sits lower and gives the shout somewhere to land.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-fs-amulya: Relaxed Patrick Hand SC scribbles with crowded, shoulder-hugging letters, and Amulya keeps its curves open and modern beside it. The loose-versus-tidy gap is the draw, and it favors brevity.
gen-gf-patrick-hand-sc-plus-jakarta-sans: Patrick Hand SC scrawls casually, with crowded letters and a line that never changes width. Plus Jakarta Sans then tidies the page with precise monoline curves, and it is good while text stays brief.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-fauna-one: Loud, open-curved Phudu grabs attention at the top, then Fauna One's tall middle band takes over the reading. Its shallow ascenders and descenders keep paragraphs dignified and unhurried down the page.
gen-gf-phudu-gf-glegoo: Punchy and sturdy, Phudu hits with constant-width arms and legs, then Glegoo's big, wide-mouthed lowercase takes over. Paragraphs in this text serif move along easily, with room in every curve.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-kadwa: Neon-tube pixels lead here, Pixelify Sans holding one unvarying line weight from edge to edge. And Kadwa, with open-ended curves and a large x-height, can sit at a modest size comfortably.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-piazzolla: Pixel-sharp and uniform in line, Pixelify Sans sets the tone with a c as open as a bent paperclip. But Piazzolla, with lowercase nearly matching its capitals, carries paragraph after paragraph with refined authority.
gen-gf-pixelify-sans-gf-scope-one: Scope One reads sturdy, its counters spilling into the surrounding space. Pixelify Sans grabs the eye with a line that never thins, while this text serif holds it with stubby ascenders and a big x-height.
